decisions.reason: The indoor air quality module is a current-generation sensor that fits the core measurement platform and has no obvious successor.
As the latest generation of the analog input module, it is a basic building block that will likely stay in the lineup for years.
Native MQTT support in the bindings makes the separate proxy largely redundant, but as low-cost software it can stay downloadable with little upkeep.
The CAN interface serves industrial users, but a newer hardware revision likely carries most demand, so dropping the first version is a real possibility.
